Local synthetic gates and read-only source review are not an independent shipping security audit.
security_and_compatibility_decisions: Initial authority is protected local service-account import; no HTTP enrollment or credentials/key establishment through an untrusted TLS edge.
All v1 wake, test and status payloads use actual 4096-byte aes128gcm binary bodies; HTTP/VAPID are distinct and no Topic header or rich content is added.
Durable exact-epoch rotation, receipt idempotency, bounded outbox/leases/retries, stale-provider recovery and legacy downgrade guards are enforced.
Destination address validation, explicit private-origin authorization, disabled implicit proxies and disabled redirects remain in place.
Logging accepts only the mollysocket namespace; more-specific external RUST_LOG directives cannot re-enable raw transport logs.
Provider acceptance is not device delivery. Provider errors cannot silently unlink Signal devices.
Legacy wake-only is disabled by default, explicitly time-bounded when enabled and cannot receive test/status/richer data.
Public readiness exposure, production release/registry publication and cross-owner implementation changes were not performed.

migration.when: Opening state with the candidate can migrate it automatically, including server startup and CLI commands. Complete the protected backup before first candidate use against an existing database.
migration.backup: Stop all writers and save a complete service-owned private backup; do not copy only a live WAL main file.
migration.rollback: Stop all writers and restore the prior binary with its matching pre-migration backup. No destructive down migration. The old binary must not open the upgraded live DB.
migration.post_restore: Keep sends disabled until fresh receiver keys/auth and a fresh instance are privately enrolled according to the restored registration lifecycle. Never resume encrypted subscriptions in plaintext.

review.attribution: Authored bundles preserve 0cwa <0@none.org> and upstream ancestry. API transport metadata remains actual GitHub-provided metadata. No fabricated signatures or signoffs.

change_control: This manifest records a new source candidate and does not change frozen C0/H0 or force any consumer pin. Future changed accepted behavior requires a new contract version and migration notes. Candidate manifest own commit is reported externally, never embedded as its own hash.
